title: Automate changelog and onboard Zenith Lite 3B v1.0 (perf + metadata + changelog automation)
author: Priya Kapoor
description: This PR onboards the Zenith Lite 3B v1.0 model into the registry and adds end-to-end automation for generating model release notes/changelog entries. Motivation: Zenith Lite was validated by research for our low-latency tier and needs a canonical manifest, performance profiles (CPU/GPU/quantized), and automated release notes so product can announce the model without manual steps. Changes include: model manifest (metadata + tags), perf profiles produced by the benchmarking pipeline, integration of the changelog-generator templates into the registry automation, CI pipeline updates to validate onboarding artifacts, and unit tests that exercise the onboarding flow. Checklist included in the description: - [x] Add model manifest (manifest.yaml) - [x] Add perf profiles (perf_profiles/*.json) - [x] Add changelog template and generator hook - [x] Add CI job for model-onboard smoke tests - [x] Add docs/examples for devs - [x] Add unit/integration tests Impact: no breaking API changes; this adds surfaced assets and automation under the model-registry service. Notes: perf profiles include quantization metadata and example benchmarking commands; changelog automation will create a draft release note in Linear when a model manifest is merged to main. See linked Linear tickets for rollout and editorial copy.

release_notes:
- Onboarded Zenith Lite 3B v1.0: added model manifest with canonical metadata and tags.
- Added performance profiles (GPU, CPU, quantized) including quantization metadata to help runtime kernel selection.
- Introduced changelog/release-note automation: model manifests merged to main will produce a draft release note in Linear and an optional changelog entry for the product blog.
- Added CI smoke tests and docs/examples for developers.
